acceptance_criteria: Two-point calibration from a known distance; metric and feet/inches input, visible scale/precision, persistence and Undo. Reject zero/ambiguous scales; verify rotation, CropBox and independent known dimensions.

Length, polyline, perimeter, polygon area and angle annotations, with editable geometry and explicit calibrated units. Recalibration recalculates values; stale or uncalibrated values never appear as valid takeoffs.

Versioned measurement records link geometry, scale, unit and annotation identity. Reopen/export without changing values silently; preserve originals and report unsupported imported measurement metadata.

Sort/filter/search all markups by page, author, date, status, discipline and custom fields; navigate to the actual annotation. Add business statuses without confusing them with standard PDF review states. CSV/JSON exports preserve unknowns and neutralize spreadsheet formulas.
Place count markers, group by equipment/type, correct/delete with Undo and export totals tied to source markers. Counts remain distinct from proposed visual-search matches.

Save/reuse/share styles, image stamps, symbols and supported annotation groups in a documented open format. Bound imports, validate assets/licenses and refuse scripts or unsafe references. Decoration presets alone do not satisfy this card.

Typed text/choice/date/number/formula columns, grouped totals and unit-price calculations; bounded expressions without executable code, explicit units/currency/rounding and reproducible exports. Prices are supplied by the user.
Named viewports with independent scales, clear overlap rules and explicit scale selection; draw shapes to real dimensions and support snapping to eligible vectors.
Explicit depth, cut-outs/holes and retained calculation inputs; unit-safe area/volume totals and tests for degenerate or self-intersecting geometry.
Named/hierarchical plan regions, deterministic assignment of annotations to regions and filters/reports by room or floor; expose overlapping/unassigned cases.

Search from a selected symbol locally, with sensitivity, rotation choices, bounded processing and candidate previews. User-accepted matches drive counts; false positives and partial searches remain explicit.

Preview a bounded region from drawing edges, allow manual closure of openings and retain holes. Convert reviewed results to measurements; document resolution/tolerance and refuse leakage or ambiguous boundaries.
Register two or more plans using explicit control points and display/export colour-separated overlays. Keep input PDFs intact; ambiguous alignment and unmatched pages require review.
Convert reviewed comparison regions into editable cloud annotations and register entries. Preserve original/revised identity and distinguish geometric changes from rendering noise.
Navigate separate PDFs as one indexed set, grouped by discipline/sheet/revision. A portable manifest preserves references; missing, moved and duplicate sheets stay visible.

Match and review incoming revisions, transfer only supported markups under an explicit geometric mapping, retain previous files and produce a per-sheet result report. Refuse unsafe transfers without partial overwrites.
Detect sheet references in searchable text/OCR, preview proposed destinations and create reviewed links in new copies. Ambiguous references, unsafe paths and missing files remain unresolved.
Generate legends, grouped quantity/issue summaries and PDF/CSV/JSON reports tied to the actual filtered annotations and document revisions. No invented or stale totals.

Export CSV/XLSX snapshots and refresh explicitly identified quantities with source revision and units. Work with open formats without requiring paid Excel; avoid macros, formula injection and silent spreadsheet overwrites.

Multiple authenticated colleagues annotate the same immutable base PDF, with author identity, event history, reconnect recovery, conflict handling and tested multi-client permissions. A document reservation is not simultaneous annotation.

Isolated companies, viewer/editor/admin roles, shared projects, immutable PDF versions, edit reservations, guarded publication and previous-version downloads. Optional desktop access; company data stays exportable. Paid managed hosting, prices later. Production SSO, backups, deployment and operations need separate evidence.

Start with documented open exchanges such as IFC and licensed fixtures. Import identifiable spaces/plan metadata with reviewed mapping. Revit/AutoCAD adapters are optional and require their own SDK and licensing checks.
Assess eligible U3D/PRC reading/rendering, annotations, resource isolation and compatible dependencies on licensed fixtures. Keep unsupported 3D content explicit; no automatic script execution.
Suggest page pairing and alignment across plan sets, with confidence, unmatched cases and user validation. Benchmark against reviewed examples before automating any replacement.
Confined, opt-in local/project access; typed allowlisted tools, bounded resources, explicit write actions and an activity record. No required commercial AI provider or cloud account for local use.

Licensed/synthetic plans with known dimensions, revisions, zones and expected counts. Cover unit conversions, four rotations/crops, encrypted PDFs, Undo/atomic failure, independent readers, accessibility and recorded physical-device performance. Synthetic tests do not close hardware or interoperability gaps.
